sources.document: Autoridad Nacional del Agua informa acciones realizadas ante huaicos y emergencias en la cuenca Chancay-Huaral
admissible_claims: ANA reported recent huaico and emergency conditions in the Chancay-Huaral basin during March 2017

the source stated a normal discharge up to 80 m3/s as contextual provider language
forbidden_inferences: 270 m3/s is an IRFEN activation threshold
80 m3/s is an IRFEN decision threshold
the basin polygon is the event footprint

sources.document: Autoridad Nacional del Agua mantiene reunión con congresista de la República
